typography.instructions: Use 'Chivo' for all headings (H1-H4) to give a strong, mechanical, and robust feel suitable for a garage environment. Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text, numbers, data tables, and input fields for maximum technical clarity. Avoid generic fonts like Inter.

colors.description: High-contrast, industrial, and clean. Deep obsidian base paired with electric blue actions and high-visibility alert colors (orange/red) for low stock warnings.

grids_and_layouts.sidebar: Collapsible left-sidebar for navigation (Dashboard, Inventory, Stock In/Out, Suppliers, Customers, Reports).
grids_and_layouts.kpi_row: Top row should be a 'North Star' row with 3-4 KPI tiles (Total Value, Low Stock Count, Today's Transactions). Use col-span-1 for summaries.
grids_and_layouts.exception_table: Anchor the bottom of the dashboard with an actionable exception table (e.g., items below reorder point).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Use dense spacing for tables (p-2 to p-4) to fit more data, but generous spacing (p-6 to p-8) between major sections.

components.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Must be highly readable with clear borders. Left-align most columns, right-align numbers (EUR, Quantities).
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (radius-md). Strong contrast for primary actions (Stock IN/OUT).
components.forms: Use Shadcn Forms with clear validation. Input types must be correct (number for quantities and prices).
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for Add/Edit item and Barcode Scanning flows to keep the user in the context.
components.charts: Use Shadcn Charts (Recharts) for Stock Valuation and Movement. Keep charts simple (Bar or Line).

visual_enhancers.borders: Use 'Grid Borders' style for dashboards (visible grid skeleton, 1px subtle borders).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal shadows. Rely on 1px borders to separate cards.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use empty state illustrations with a clear CTA (e.g., 'Add your first inventory item').

motion.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-[1px]) and border color change for interactive cards.
motion.transitions: Use specific transitions: `transition-colors duration-200`, `transition-transform duration-200`. Do NOT use `transition-all`.
motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations for inventory list items.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast against backgrounds, especially for gray text in dark mode.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="stock-in-submit"`).
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on inputs (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary`).

media_and_assets.icons: Use `lucide-react` (default) for a crisp, functional look.

login_background.description: Dark, sleek car in a garage workshop. Use as a split-screen background for the Login/Register page.

empty_inventory.description: Mechanic tools flatlay. Use for empty state when no inventory exists.

specific_functionalities.barcode_generation: Use a library like `react-barcode` to generate Code128 barcodes.
specific_functionalities.barcode_scanning: Integrate a webcam scanner using a library like `react-qr-reader` or `html5-qrcode` or `react-webcam-barcode-scanner`. Provide a manual entry fallback.
specific_functionalities.currency: Format all monetary values as EUR (€).
specific_functionalities.jwt_auth: Store JWT securely and handle session expiry gracefully.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'Chivo' and 'IBM Plex Sans' in index.html.
Remove default boilerplate CSS in App.css and index.css.
Use standard Shadcn components for complex interactions.
Ensure the dashboard is operational/action-first (e.g., one-click 'Restock' from low stock alerts).
Do NOT use HTML `<select>` or `<input type='date'>`, use Shadcn Select and Calendar.
Apply `data-testid` to all buttons, inputs, and major links.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center align the App container.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Ensure robust toast notifications using Sonner.
